notes: «3683 -» is a report number; «رُوِيَ عَنْ» gives Mu'awiya as the first link; «قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ» makes the Imam the source of the answer (rule 5); «عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» is a blessing; the Prophet's words inside the matn are not a chain; the matn begins at «إِنَّهُ ذُكِرَ لَنَا»
